comments.author: fertro
comments.body_html:
This mod is a godsend for my Alt F4-happy fingers, but there seems to be an issue with Insurance.

Insurance doesn’t seem to save after death or extraction, so if I insure a helmet and extract, once I’m back in my stash, the helmet is no longer insured. Insured items lost on death (or dropped in raid, extract or not) don’t seem to be saved either, as the message saying “We’ll find your stuff” doesn’t pop up. No idea if it’s the mod or SPT’s built-in functionality, but it happens consistently with the mod installed, but Insurance works normally without it.
